about: A generic county magistracy declared in feet from docs/building-programs.md's county magistrate's manor program and its knobs (feature 449 T152: the program the old builder held, rebuilt from the program's prose and the sheet's notes, never read from the old code); each size inside its band of the type's declaration, each knob recorded in the sheet's notes and re-rolled from the seed here.
research: the house at the record's size - research/questions/0091-samurai-residences-and-their-rooms-buke-yashiki.drawing.html: the residence 56 x 24 ft with its veranda, the kitchen 20 x 18 and the bath 10 x 8, about 50 tsubo, the 150-koku district magistrate's house the plan is measured against

its rooms in the palace order's lesser form - GUESS: the reception room at the east end the full depth, the master's rooms beside it on the garden row, the family's beyond, the inner rooms and the maids' room behind (research/questions/0091-samurai-residences-and-their-rooms-buke-yashiki.drawing.html); the room sizes the kinds' guesses

the lodgings' dwellings - research/questions/0097-staff-rowhouses-and-barracks-nagaya.drawing.html, research/questions/0106-the-chief-retainers-house-karo-yashiki.drawing.html: the barracks in four dwellings of about 17.5 ft, the senior retainers' long-house in the karo's bay of 14 ft and four dwellings of about 17 ft, the servants' row in four of 15 ft, a door to each

the sizes in their bands - GUESS: the office hall 127 x 38 (113 ft before its armory bay, feature 449 T265), the armory 14 x 20 (its band 12-24 x 12-40 ft from size-audit 2026-11-22: Kaibara's eight-mat gate-range rooms, and a county hall's end bay at full depth, an estimate), the tax archive 18 x 24, the granary 50 x 27, the barracks 23 x 70, the long-house 24 x 82, the servants' row 60 x 15, the stables 18 x 24, the storehouses 19 x 16 and 18 x 12 (each wide enough to hold its two-line name), the gatehouse 40 x 12, the guest house 40 x 42, the shrine 18 x 14 and the cell 12 x 10, each inside its band of the type's declaration (l7r/diagram/buildings/types.json)

the west storehouse larger than the record's - DEVIATION research/questions/0091-samurai-residences-and-their-rooms-buke-yashiki.html: the common household storehouse about 12 x 18 ft and the Yokota house's unequal pair about 9 x 12 and 18 x 15 ft; storehouse (W) is drawn 19 x 16 ft, a departure past the common size toward Yokota's larger store, so that it holds its two-line name, and storehouse (E) 18 x 12 ft at the common size

the start along the north wall - GUESS: the house's search starts 102 ft along the north wall, so the kitchen ell, the rear yard and the vegetable garden stand west of it and the garden before it, the program's start knob (the derivation's slack: no rule fixes the start end)

the granary on the offices' side - research/questions/0123-the-magistrates-manor-in-a-town-where-it-stands-and-which-way-it-faces-jinya-and-yamen.html: Pingyao built office buildings behind its war, justice and works offices "and north of them the county granary", on the office side, not in the residence's court (building-review 2026-11-22 E1); the granary in the office court, never the household's (feature 449 T274; T265's seat in the inner court and its north cart gate withdrawn)

the granary at the head of the east column - GUESS research/questions/0123-the-magistrates-manor-in-a-town-where-it-stands-and-which-way-it-faces-jinya-and-yamen.drawing.html: the plan has no side-wing offices for Pingyao's seat north of them to be drawn against, so the granary stands at the head of the office court's east column, its north face on the divider, beside the office hall's east end, its door on its west face toward the hall's east end and the middle gate, its carts by the south service gate and the cart yard; the hall drawn 27 ft forward with the granary behind it was measured and left (27 ft more envelope owes about 1,050 to 1,450 sq ft more building at the coverage floor, and the clerks' rowhouse that would pay it is ruled out by the commuting clerks CANON; docs/building-programs.md records the acceptance; feature 449 T274)

the barracks below the granary - GUESS: the east column flows down from the granary, so the barracks fills the office court's south-east corner (building-review 2026-11-22 E2: T265 slid it north and left a bare 31 x 31 ft corner), its privy at its north end; the office hall centered in its free ground (58.5 to 185.5 ft) and the hearing court, with the outer court's two grounds beside it, re-cut 14 ft west to keep it under the dais (feature 449 T274)

the armory in the office hall's west end bay - research/questions/0123-the-magistrates-manor-in-a-town-where-it-stands-and-which-way-it-faces-jinya-and-yamen.html: Pingyao, with no standing barracks, kept its armory in the great hall's west end bay; the one-bay gate rolled here leaves no gate range for Kaibara's store of arms (0093; no firearm named, the setting silent on them, the session's ruling 2026-11-22), so the hall's bay, 14 x 20 ft in its back row (its size a GUESS, larger than Kaibara's eight-mat gate-range room of about 12 ft square, 0097; the back row rather than Pingyao's full-depth bay a GUESS, so the hall's west door opens onto its front), the hall 14 ft longer for it (feature 449 T265)
